items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And John Sanders and Britt Woodman and myself were the trombones

ctx.x: And John Sanders and Britt Woodman and myself were the trombones, but the trombone section to me was impeccable. Clean. I don't care, anything we played it was clean. We don't care what the other band -- how good they played or how bad they played. We always played good --
